risks.title: Memory leak in QGIS trajectory processing module
risks.mitigation: Profile memory allocation in processing loop using memory_profiler. Add ceiling threshold at 80% heap usage. Add regression test asserting memory release after each batch.
risks.contingency: Roll back to v1.2 trajectory engine if memory consumption exceeds 4GB on staging

risks.title: Drone trajectory calculation diverges at altitude > 200m
risks.mitigation: Revert PR#42 to stable algorithm. Engage aerospace consultant to review physics model. Add altitude boundary validation in pre-flight checks.
risks.contingency: Cap operational altitude at 150m until algorithm is validated by external review

risks.title: Single senior developer with domain knowledge of geospatial pipeline
risks.mitigation: Schedule 2 knowledge transfer sessions in Sprint 4. Document geospatial pipeline architecture in Confluence. Cross-train one junior developer on the module.
risks.contingency: Engage external GIS consultant on retainer if key developer is unavailable for > 5 days
